structured_output.what_is_happening: DDOS ("Degens Dollars On Solana") is a pump.fun coin that migrated to PumpSwap about 10 minutes after launch. Its only social link is a Polymarket X status (https://x.com/Polymarket/status/2103653913823961467). The fetch returned HTTP 402, so I could not read the post. Presumably Polymarket posted the phrase and it spawned more than 10 same-name clones. This contract leads them by market cap. It peaked at about $171k (GMGN ATH), was $123k at detection and was about $82k at a live DexScreener check (https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/tokens/zpTj1yA68UauZqdz5276qrpTV7ALkeoLp9LLa7Bpump), with m5 down 38%. Trade count is high (773 buys and 631 sells in 5 minutes), but 418 bundler-tagged wallets and a 70% bot/degen rate point to a lot of manufactured flow.

narrative.description: A meme name taken from a Polymarket X post, apparently about Solana degens. Polymarket was reportedly posting viral, later-deleted tweets about Solana tokens around 2026-09-24 (KuCoin feed), so crowds are chasing its posts.
narrative.why_spreading: A large brand account (Polymarket) posted it, and a recent deleted Polymarket tweet teasing a Solana token went viral, so traders are watching Polymarket's posts for coins to buy.

token_connection.why_this_token: Of the listed same-name tokens, it has the highest market cap and volume and deep PumpSwap liquidity ($25-29k). It is the de facto leader. It was not the first launch: 6hHJ8 launched earlier, and 26BUcvg3, 8DMRzh and FDT6 were created a little earlier too.
token_connection.competing_tokens: More than 10 same-name DDOS clones. Several have $20-31k liquidity and high volume (FDT6covX $250k h1, 9zMghu, E2t6v, H3RUSv), which splits attention.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 1,356 unique buyers, 38 smart wallets and 5 renowned wallets. Against that: 418 bundler wallets, a 70% bot/degen rate, a 32.7% top-bundler trader share and a community-takeover flag. No paid DexScreener boosts.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the Polymarket post (HTTP 402), and I found no indexed X discussion of this contract.

structural_risks: Price is falling hard: down about 50% from the $171k ATH, and m5 is down 17-38%

structured_output.counterargument: Polymarket is a huge account and this contract is the leading one, with LP burned, mint and freeze renounced and top-10 holders at about 22%. Another Polymarket post or wider coverage could send it back through its ATH to $160k+ from an ~$80k entry, which would be a 2x.

How much of the flow is bundled wash trading

source_coverage.notes: Contract search returned nothing. The X post was blocked by HTTP 402. A KuCoin feed item shows Polymarket posting and then deleting a viral tweet about a Solana token around 09-24. Reddit, Telegram and Discord were not searched because of the time limit.

structured_output.thesis: A brand-driven clone war in which this contract leads, but it is already down about 50% from its ATH and falling fast, with heavy bundler and bot activity. A 2x from an entry around $80k needs a fresh catalyst. Below-average to average odds for this pool.
